d: USRC’s greatest strength in being a leader in the dialysis industry is our ability to recognize and celebrate the differences in our diverse workforce. We strongly believe in recruiting top talent and creating a diverse and inclusive work climate and culture at all levels of our organization.

Responsible for delivering high-quality, comprehensive nursing care to patients undergoing dialysis treatment in a clinical setting. This role involves assessing patient needs, implementing individualized care plans, and monitoring patients’ conditions to ensure optimal health outcomes. Collaborates with a multidisciplinary team to ensure a safe and effective treatment environment while following established protocols and standards of care.
Provide total patient care according to core standards, established policies, and evidence-based practices.
Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate individualized patient care plans.
Collaborate with the Nurse Supervisor and Head Nurse to reduce patient waiting times and achieve unit goals.
Maintain accurate and timely patient documentation.
Report equipment failures, safety concerns, security issues, and low supply inventory.
Maintain familiarity with emergency equipment and procedures.
Review patient medication profiles monthly and administer medications as prescribed.
Obtain laboratory samples as ordered and promptly report critical results and urgent patient needs to the physician.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to continuously improve patient care and advocate for patients and families.
Identify opportunities to improve care quality and address issues that may negatively affect patient outcomes.
Promote patient and staff safety, comply with infection prevention policies, and report potential risks.
Support cost efficiency through responsible use of staff, equipment, and supplies.
Contribute to clinical quality indicators and patient satisfaction.
Lead assigned unit-based performance improvement activities.
Participate in new staff orientation, mentoring, and the development of nursing students and new employees.
Apply transcultural principles in nursing practice.
Participate in special projects aligned with nursing strategic priorities and evidence-based practice.
Follow all Dialysis Centre policies and procedures.
Participate in professional education, training, and development.
Promote USRC’s values of Excellence, Partnership, Inclusion, and Compassion.
Support teamwork and comply with company policies and procedures.
q: Registered Nurse (RN) with a Bachelor’s or Higher Diploma in Nursing.
Non-Saudi applicants must have at least two (2) years of nursing experience in a haemodialysis unit.
Saudi applicants with no prior experience may be enrolled in the New Graduate Development Program.
Current nursing license from the country of origin or a valid license from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS).
Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the Saudi Heart Association or American Heart Association.
Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification is preferred.
Completion of a haemodialysis training program is an advantage.
Must pass a color vision test.

d: Aldar Academies is currently seeking a Teacher - English at Yas American Academy on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi for an Immediate start.
This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi's leading school group.

Yas American Academy opened in September 2016 providing high quality education to the Emirate. The children are taught the Massachusetts Common Core Curriculum - tailored to be meaningful to children attending the school, alongside the local curriculum of Arabic, Islamic Studies and Social Studies. Facilities at the school are excellent and include a large astro-turf field, two swimming pools, well stocked library, a large multi-purpose sports hall, an auditorium and outdoor play areas.
We provide a warm, friendly and supportive environment where students enjoy learning and achieving in an atmosphere of mutual respect and trust.
The successful candidates will be closely aligned with our core values and ethos and possess a genuine understanding and appreciation of the values of the region.
q: Minimum of a Bachelor degree in the relevant subject and B.Ed. or PGCE Education
Experience in an international school is an advantage
Applicants should have experience in teaching AP/IB or A-Levels standard.
Previous experience working with students whom English is not their first language
Passion for teaching and commitment to educating the whole child
A high level of professionalism and consideration of the well-being of children
Recent and consistent involvement in extra-curricular activities
Respect for all members of a school community, irrespective of position, gender, age and ethnic background
A positive and solution-focused attitude to working life
A clean enhanced Disclosure and Barring Services check or police check

This job description is not all-inclusive. Aldar Education reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. Aldar Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Offers of appointment are subject to satisfactory references and police clearance.
